content_of_post_to_answer: I always fix myself to someone who has been affected by injustice and overthinking. What if it had happened to me? How would I have responded to that? How do I overcome this?
answer: What you are describing is empathy becoming identification. Caring about someone’s suffering is healthy; mentally placing yourself inside their pain can make you relive an event that is not yours to carry. A useful distinction is: “How can I understand this person?” rather than “What if I were this person?” Compassion needs a boundary, because without one, another person’s injustice can quietly become your own ongoing wound.
